description:
À propos

Diduenjoy est un logiciel SaaS qui va plus loin qu’un simple outil de questionnaire de satisfaction (NPS, CSAT) qui fournirait des « analytics » et un « dashboard ».

La mission de Diduenjoy est d’aider les marques à améliorer l’expérience de leurs clients. L’objectif est d’arriver à comprendre les besoins des clients et de mieux prédire leurs comportements.

Depuis sa création en 2014, les associés de Diduenjoy ont choisi développer leur logiciel SaaS sans réaliser de levée de fonds dans un marché très concurrentiel.

Trop souvent la levée de fonds est présentée comme un passage obligé pour la croissance des entreprises ! Comme si le succès et la crédibilité d’une startup reposaient sur le montant de la levée, le nom de prestigieux investisseurs et le passage sur BMF Business ou Smart TV… au lieu de regarder des critères comme la rentabilité, la fidélisation des clients, le bien être des employés…

Cette obsession à la levée de fonds met d’ailleurs souvent en péril les startups dont la survie est conditionnée à la réussite de la prochaine levée… Ce qui anime les fondateurs de Diduenjoy, c’est de concentrer tous leurs efforts pour construire la meilleure solution du marché, signer de nouveaux contrats, accompagner des clients, convaincre des candidats talentueux de les rejoindre et d’y rester.

Cette stratégie semble payante puisque Diduenjoy connait une croissance de 70% par an tout en restant rentable, réussit à gagner des appels d’offres face à des sociétés concurrentes américaines valorisées plusieurs milliards et à fidéliser ses équipes. Diduenjoy compte aujourd’hui 150 clients dont LVMH, L’Oréal, SMCP, BNP Paribas.

Il ne s'agit pas d'une offre d'alternance.

Il ne s'agit pas d'une offre pour un stage de développement mais d'un stage ouvrier.

Il ne s'agit pas d'une offre pour un stage de fin d'étude.

Les candidatures pour l'un de ces points ne seront pas traitées



Diduenjoy récolte chaque mois pour le compte de ses entreprises clientes via ses questionnaires de satisfaction (NPS, CSAT...)

Identifier les tendances.
Participer à l'amélioration de la technologie.

Vous ne serez pas amené à faire du développement lors de ce stage.

Des connaissances et un intérêt pour le domaine de la mode et du luxe seront un plus sans être un critère limitant

job_title: Ingénieur en science des données IA H/F - IBM Client Innovation Center
description:
Introduction

Une carrière chez IBM Consulting s'appuie sur des relations à long terme et une collaboration étroite avec des clients du monde entier.

Vous travaillerez avec des visionnaires dans de multiples secteurs pour améliorer les parcours du cloud hybride, de l'IA et des différentes activités métiers pour les entreprises les plus innovantes et les plus précieuses au monde. Votre capacité à accélérer l'impact et à apporter des changements significatifs pour vos clients est rendue possible par notre écosystème de partenaires stratégiques et nos plateformes technologiques robustes à travers le portefeuille IBM ; y compris Software et Red Hat.

La curiosité et la recherche constante de connaissances sont les fondements de la réussite au sein d'IBM Consulting. Dans votre rôle, vous serez encouragé à remettre en question la norme, à rechercher des idées en dehors de votre rôle et à trouver des solutions créatives qui auront un impact révolutionnaire pour un large réseau de clients. Notre culture de l'évolution et de l'empathie est axée sur l'évolution de carrière à long terme et les opportunités de développement dans un environnement qui prend en compte vos compétences et votre expérience uniques.

Your Role And Responsibilities

Dans le cadre de notre développement stratégique autour de l’IA générative, des modèles de fondation (LLM, vision, multimodal) et des problématiques métiers complexes, nous recherchons un(e) Data Scientist expérimenté(e), qui sera acteur clé dans l’exploration, l’expérimentation et la mise en production de solutions innovantes, avec un focus particulier sur la détection de fraude documentaire, un domaine à fort enjeu technique et éthique.

Veille & Collaboration Recherche :
Assurer une veille technologique active sur les nouvelles architectures de modèles de fondation, ainsi que l’état de l’art des technologies et frameworks IA.
Réaliser des benchmarks de modèles et algorithmes existants pour en évaluer la pertinence selon les cas d’usage métiers.
Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de recherche IBM et les équipes projets pour évaluer des solutions innovantes et leur faisabilité de déploiement sur l’infrastructure du client.
Être l’interface entre les avancées scientifiques et leur mise en œuvre concrète.
Identifier et proposer de nouveaux cas d’usage IA liés à la data et à l’IA générative.
Modélisation & Entraînement
Concevoir, entraîner et adapter des modèles de machine learning, de vision par ordinateur et de fondation (LLM/VLM), avec un focus sur la détection de fraude documentaire.
Gérer les complexités liées à la création de jeux de données équilibrés : rareté de la fraude, génération de données synthétiques, évaluation réaliste de la performance, gestion du biais.
Rédiger et optimiser des prompts pour différents modèles de fondation (LLaMa, Granite, Mistral, etc.) adaptés à des tâches spécifiques (classification, extraction, QA…).
Déploiement & Bonnes Pratiques
Accompagner les équipes dans le déploiement de modèles IA en production, avec un focus fort sur l’optimisation des performances sur des infrastructures GPU (latence, consommation mémoire, batching…).
Promouvoir les bonnes pratiques en data science : gestion du versioning des modèles (MLflow…), reproductibilité, documentation, robustesse et équité des modèles.
Participer à la montée en compétences des équipes à travers des sessions de partage, du mentorat ou des ateliers techniques.

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

Langages & frameworks : Maîtrise de Python et de bibliothèques ML/DL telles que PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, scikit-learn, OpenCV, TensorFlow (souhaité).

Modélisation avancée :
Expérience en machine learning supervisé (XGBoost, LightGBM, SVM, modèles linéaires) sur données structurées ou comportementales.
Très bonne maîtrise des modèles deep learning appliqués à la vision :
OCR (TrOCR, Donut, Tesseract),
Classification d’images (ResNet, ViT, EfficientNet),
Object detection (YOLO, Mask R-CNN, Detectron2),
Parsing et layout analysis de documents complexes.
Fine-tuning ou adaptation (LoRA, prompt tuning) de LLMs / VLMs (BERT, RoBERTa, LLaMA, GPT, Mistral, CLIP, BLIP) pour :
Détection d’anomalies sémantiques,
Rapprochement texte-image,
Analyse multimodale dans des documents falsifiés.
Génération & gestion des datasets :
Création de jeux de données synthétiques (text-to-image, augmentation, falsification contrôlée),
Gestion du déséquilibre (focal loss, over/undersampling, data weighting),
Anonymisation et prétraitement documentaire (PDF parsing, OCR structuré).
Prompt engineering : Rédaction et optimisation de prompts pour des modèles de fondation dans différents contextes (classification, extraction, RAG…).
Déploiement & performance GPU :
Optimisation de modèles pour l’inférence temps réel (ONNX, TorchScript, TensorRT),
Mise en production sur infrastructure GPU (Triton, FastAPI, batching intelligent, vLLM, quantization),
Monitoring, A/B testing, gestion des dérives.
Suivi des expériences & reproductibilité :
MLflow, Weights & Biases, Git, DVC,
Construction de pipelines de training robustes et traçables.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

O Que Você Fará

Projetar e Desenvolver Agentes de IA: Realizar o desenvolvimento e manutenção de ferramentas e pipelines para agentes de IA, com foco em padrões como Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), function-calling e fluxos de trabalho multi-agente para diferentes modalidades (web, chat e voz).

Princípios de Código Limpo: Aplicação de princípios de Programação Orientada a Objetos (POO), Design Patterns e Clean Code.
Prompt Engineering: Experiência prática e sólida compreensão das técnicas de prompt engineering para otimização do desempenho e comportamento de LLMs.
Inglês Técnico: Capacidade de ler e escrever documentação técnica e de APIs em inglês.

Diferenciais

Desenvolvimento de Voz e Multimodal: Experiência com projetos em produção envolvendo tecnologias de voz (Twilio, Amazon Connect, Azure Speech) e agentes TTS/STT (Whisper, AssemblyAI).
Desenvolvimento Frontend: Experiência com frameworks modernos de frontend, como React/Next.js, Vue.js/Nuxt.js ou Svelte, para a construção de interfaces ricas.
Infraestrutura e DevOps: Conhecimento de ferramentas de infraestrutura como código e orquestração de containers (Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible).
Avaliação e Fine-tuning de Modelos: Experiência com fine-tuning ou instrução de modelos (LoRA, PEFT) e ferramentas de avaliação de qualidade de LLMs (LLM-Evals, Promptbench, Ragas).

O Que Oferecemos

description:
¿Te gustaría formar parte de un proyecto que apuesta por la tecnología y la sostenibilidad?

En Talent Clau colaboramos con una startup ubicada en Sant Cugat del Vallès que está reinventando la logística urbana mediante una red propia de puntos de recogida y una plataforma inteligente basada en IA generativa. ¿El objetivo? Hacer que el tramo final de la entrega de paquetes sea más fácil, flexible y sostenible.

Con una base tecnológica sólida y en plena expansión, el equipo quiere incorporar a un/a Project Manager con perfil técnico, capaz de organizar y conectar equipos para afrontar nuevos retos y contribuir al crecimiento del proyecto.


¿Cuáles serán tus funciones?


Coordinarás los proyectos desde su inicio hasta su lanzamiento.
Evaluarás los recursos necesarios para los proyectos y apoyarás la planificación de la carga de los equipos, aplicando métodos como story points o t-shirt sizing.
Realizarás un seguimiento exhaustivo del tiempo imputado, presupuesto y evolución de los objetivos, asegurando la trazabilidad.
Gestionarás la estructura de trabajo en Jira (épicas, flujos de trabajo y paneles).
Contribuirás a mantener un buen ritmo de trabajo mediante reuniones de seguimiento regulares y puntos de revisión, siguiendo principios de la metodología Agile.
Colaborarás con los equipos de QA.
Trabajarás junto al equipo de DevOps para asegurar despliegues controlados e integración de puntos de control de calidad.
Mantendrás el alineamiento entre producto, desarrollo y operaciones.
Identificarás riesgos y áreas de mejora.
Reportarás el estado de los proyectos al COO y al CTO de forma clara y estructurada.


¿Qué buscamos?


Experiencia mínima de 3 años liderando proyectos tecnológicos en entornos digitales.
Conocimientos técnicos y experiencia mínima de 5 años en desarrollo, con capacidad para comprender el contexto técnico y trabajar con los equipos de programación.
Formación universitaria en Ingeniería Informática, Multimedia, Telecomunicaciones u otras similares.
Experiencia en planificación de proyectos y control de horas trabajadas, asegurando un registro preciso para el seguimiento interno y la facturación.
Experiencia utilizando Jira y Confluence.
Familiaridad con técnicas de estimación como story points y t-shirt sizing.
Nivel avanzado de castellano e inglés, tanto oral como escrito.


Se valorará:


Experiencia trabajando con entornos de desarrollo Node.js / NestJS.
Conocimientos técnicos de React Native.
Familiaridad con servicios de IA generativa como OpenAI, Azure Open AI, Google DeepMind, LLaMA u otros similares.
Conocimientos de cultura DevOps y procesos de despliegue (CI/CD).
Experiencia previa como Release Manager o colaborando estrechamente con equipos de QA.
Habilidad para trabajar con herramientas de BI (Power BI, Looker...).
Certificaciones profesionales (PMP, PMI-ACP, Scrum Master...).
Conocimiento y experiencia en enfoques como Agile y Lean, así como en metodologías y modelos de gestión como Kanban o Flight Levels, aplicados a la mejora del flujo de trabajo y la alineación de equipos.
Experiencia en startups o entornos en crecimiento.
Experiencia en entornos internacionales.


¿Qué ofrecemos?


Un entorno cercano, dinámico y ágil, con espacio para proponer, aportar y crecer. Valoramos la iniciativa y la mejora continua.
Posibilidad de tener un rol clave en la definición y crecimiento de un proyecto.
Modelo híbrido: 3 días presenciales en oficina y 2 días en remoto.
Salario bruto anual entre 37.000 € y 40.000 €, según perfil y experiencia. Con posibilidad de crecimiento a medida que crece el proyecto.
25 días laborables de vacaciones + 1 día libre por tu cumpleaños.
Jornada completa con horario flexible (se recomienda iniciar la jornada a las 8:00 h). Se pueden estudiar otras opciones siempre que se respeten las operativas del equipo.
Contrato indefinido, directamente con la empresa.


¿Crees que este proyecto encaja contigo? Envía tu CV a marinavalls@talentclau.com

description:
Empresa: BETWEEN Technology

Ubicación: Remoto

Experiencia requerida: 3 años

Descripción del puesto

En BETWEEN Technology, estamos en la búsqueda de un Profesional en Inteligencia Artificial (IA) altamente capacitado y motivado para unirse a nuestro equipo como IA Developer. Si tienes una sólida experiencia de al menos 3 años en el desarrollo de soluciones basadas en IA, esta es tu oportunidad para formar parte de una empresa innovadora y dinámica que se encuentra a la vanguardia de la transformación digital.

Responsabilidades

Como IA Developer, Serás Responsable De

Diseñar, desarrollar e implementar algoritmos de inteligencia artificial y aprendizaje automático para resolver problemas complejos.
Colaborar con equipos multidisciplinarios para identificar requisitos y traducirlos en soluciones viables en IA.
Realizar investigación y análisis de las últimas tendencias en IA y aprendizaje automático, y aplicar este conocimiento para mejorar nuestros proyectos y servicios.
Desarrollar prototipos de IA y realizar pruebas para garantizar la efectividad y eficiencia de las soluciones implementadas.
Documentar y presentar tus hallazgos y recomendaciones a las partes interesadas para apoyar la toma de decisiones estratégicas.

Requisitos

Para tener éxito en este puesto, el candidato ideal debe cumplir con los siguientes requisitos:

Título universitario en Informática, Ingeniería, Matemáticas o áreas relacionadas.
Mínimo 3 años de experiencia como IA Developer o en un rol relacionado.
Sólidos conocimientos en algoritmos de aprendizaje automático, deep learning y técnicas de procesamiento de datos.
Experiencia en lenguajes de programación relevantes, como Python, Java o R.
Familiaridad con frameworks y bibliotecas de IA populares, como TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch o Scikit-learn.
Habilidades analíticas excepcionales y capacidad para resolver problemas de manera creativa.
Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, tanto verbales como escritas, y capacidad para trabajar en equipo.

Competencias valoradas

Además de los requisitos mencionados, valoramos las siguientes competencias:

Capacidad para adaptarse rápidamente a nuevas tecnologías y metodologías.
Interés genuino en la IA y un deseo de seguir aprendiendo en este campo en constante evolución.
Experiencia en desarrollo de aplicaciones basadas en la nube y uso de servicios como AWS o Google Cloud Platform.
Conocimientos en técnicas de procesamiento de lenguaje natural (NLP) y visión por computadora son un plus.

Qué ofrecemos

En BETWEEN Technology, valoramos a nuestros empleados y creemos que su desarrollo profesional es clave para nuestro éxito colectivo. Ofrecemos:

Un entorno de trabajo colaborativo y creativo que fomenta la innovación.
Oportunidades de formación y desarrollo continuo en el campo de la IA y tecnologías emergentes.
Proyectos desafiantes que tienen un impacto real en nuestras soluciones y en la satisfacción del cliente.

description:
Christensen Farms is one of the largest, family-owned pork producers in the United States, marketing approximately 3 million hogs per year. Headquartered in Sleepy Eye, Minnesota, the company operates throughout the Midwest with facilities in Minnesota, Iowa, Nebraska, Illinois and South Dakota. Christensen Farms owns three feed mills, manages 145,000 sows on 44 farms, and oversees more than 350 nurseries and grow-finish sites. The company employees nearly 1,000 people and maintains 1,500 contract partnerships.

The company is vertically integrated with a strong presence across the pork value chain from farm to fork. Christensen Farms is the largest shareholder of Triumph Foods LLC, a producer-owned primary pork processing plant in St. Joseph, Missouri. In turn, Triumph Foods members own 50 percent of Daily's Premium Meats, a specialty pork processor of bacon and other premium pork products. Triumph Foods also holds a 50 percent partnership in Seaboard Triumph Foods, LLC of Sioux City, Iowa, a primary pork processing plant.

Position Overview & Responsibilities

Christensen Farms is seeking a Feed Mill Maintenance Mechanic at our Forest City, IA Feed Mill. This position will be responsible to ensure all Feed Mill equipment is in proper working order while assessing any possible preventative maintenance. Service, repair, and recondition will be necessary on Feed Mill Equipment and machinery, new or used. This position will be expected to maintain and operate shop equipment and tools and perform quality repairs, as quickly and efficiently as possible.

Work Schedule: Monday - Friday from 8am - 5pm; On-call every other week (Sunday - Saturday) for after hours repairs

Major Areas of Accountability

Responsible for 100% timely completion of the set maintenance program as defined on a weekly, monthly, quarterly or yearly basis.
Responsible for any as needed maintenance as directed by the different facets of the Feed Mill.
Responsible for communication of any maintenance issues to Plant Manager.
Ensure all safety mechanisms are in complete operation and area maintained on a timely basis.
Diagnose problems and determine what repairs are needed.
Perform any inspections as required.
Keep accurate, easy-to-read records of work performed.
Responsible to research potential repair options and propose changes/purchases to Plant Manager.
Responsible to ensure accurate and efficient work order process.
Maintain and care for all shop tools, machines, and equipment.
Help maintain cleanliness, neatness, and safety of work area and building.
Coordinate with Plant Manager for scheduled Repair & Maintenance.
Responsible for staying current with technical and safety changes, continuing education if necessary.
Must provide seasonal assistance with the operation of corn piling/retrieving and snow removal.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Education, Training, And Experience Requirements

Minimum of 2+ years experience in a maintenance related field.
Knowledge of electrical, welding, cutting, plumbing, general carpentry, heating, and air conditioners.
Working understanding of computers.
Ability to understand and follow instructions in English.
Ability to operate large machinery.
Lift a minimum of 50 pounds.

No employee of CF will discriminate against any applicant for employment or a fellow employee because of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, citizenship status, genetic information, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, military status, veteran status or any other prohibited basis under applicable local, state, or federal law.

description:
Over deze vacature

Werken aan de meest toffe en uiteenlopende werktuigbouwkundige ontwerpen!

De functie

Een afwisselende en dynamische functie die de rollen van werkvoorbereider en hardware engineer combineert. Behaal de mooiste resultaten met projecten in industriële automatisering als Project Engineer Industriële Automatisering. Vanwege de veelzijdigheid van deze baan kun jij je hierin volop ontwikkelen. Kortom, werk aan allerlei projecten bij deze opdrachtgever.Jij houdt het overzicht met een goede planning, duidelijke technische tekeningen én benodigdheden die dankzij jou op tijd geregeld zijn. Doordat jij volledig op de hoogte bent van je lopende projecten, ben jij dé sparringpartner voor klanten en collega’s. Hier kun je werken binnen twee verschillende clusters: Industrie en Water & Infra. Bijvoorbeeld een project voor de foodsector of machinebouw. Of voor waterschappen, zoals een project rondom een drinkwaterpompstation. Twee totaal verschillende technische projecten! En daar mag jij je helemaal in uitleven als gedreven Project Engineer Industriële Automatisering. Je bent dan onder andere bezig met het:Maken van calculaties en opstellen van offertes aan de hand van offerteaanvragen.Verwerken van de klantwensen in een ontwerp, inclusief elektrotechnische schema’s en berekeningen.Voorbereiden en uitvoeren van projecten van A tot Z: van een ontwerp en planning tot en met de oplevering bij de klant.Verantwoordelijkheid dragen voor vervangingsklussen of aanpassingen met een korte doorlooptijd.Aanwezig zijn op locaties om vragen te beantwoorden en de voortgang te bewaken.

Over het bedrijf

Deze opdrachtgever is altijd in beweging en bestaat al meer dan 100 jaar. Dé technische dienstverlener die van A tot Z ontzorgt. Denk aan het ontwerpen, installeren en onderhouden van elektronische en werktuigbouwkundige installaties. Voor het bedrijfsleven, de industrie, zorginstellingen, scholen en particulieren. Om zo bij te dragen aan bijvoorbeeld 1.542.687 kW opgewekte zonnestroom en zo’n 7 miljoen liter schoon drinkwater.

Aanbod

25 vakantiedagen en 13 ATV-dagen, een perfecte balans tussen werk en vrije tijd!Een goed salaris dat bij je past.Altijd blijven leren! Volg trainingen en opleidingen om jezelf te ontwikkelen.Opleidingsbudget zowel bij de opdrachtgever als bij YER

Jouw profiel

Hoe technisch het werk ook is, het blijft mensenwerk. Jij bent het best te beschrijven als veelzijdig, klantvriendelijk én resultaatgericht. Want als na jouw project alles werkt en de klant tevreden is, geeft dat jou een kick. Daarnaast beschik je als toegewijde Project Engineer Industriële Automatisering over:Hbo-diploma Industriële Automatisering of Elektrotechniek of vergelijkbaar niveau door werkervaring;Ervaring met EPLAN en AutoCAD;Rijbewijs B en certificaat VCA VOL. Heb je dit certificaat nog niet, dan kun je het bij ons behalen.Goed om te weten: dit zijn onze richtlijnen. Beschik jij over andere kwaliteiten? Die ook bij deze functie passen? Geweldig! Inspireer ons met jouw sollicitatie op deze vacature

Salarisomschrijving

€3000.00 - €4500.00 monthly

Votre travail permettra de créer des environnements intelligents pilotés par capteurs, adaptés à l'IA, au service des infrastructures publiques, éducatives et de mobilité.

Projet interdisciplinaire en collaboration avec la VUB

Déployer et maintenir des réseaux de capteurs environnementaux sur le SmartCampus et les autres sites pilotes

Programmer des microcontrôleurs et intégrer des dispositifs IoT dans des architectures connectées
Participer à des activités de co-création et de science citoyenne liées à l’AIoT
Documenter l’architecture technique et contribuer aux démonstrations publiques

Être titulaire d’un master reconnu par la FWB en orientation électronique, automatisation, informatique industrielle, systèmes embarqués, IA)
Une première expérience concrète dans le cadre d’un stage, d’un projet de fin d’études ou d’un job étudiant technique est acceptée

description:
Description

En tant que Développeuse ou Développeur de jeux IA, vous créez et supportez des systèmes, mécaniques et outils d’intelligence artificielle. Vous travaillez étroitement avec les équipes de conception et de développement de jeu afin de les guider vers une implémentation robuste et évolutive. Vous collaborez avec vos pairs et vous intégrez votre travail avec les autres ingrédients du jeu afin d’offrir aux joueuses et aux joueurs une expérience unique.

Rejoindre Amazon Games Montréal, c'est contribuer à la fondation d'un nouveau studio de jeux vidéo à taille humaine; participer à la création d'une nouvelle propriété intellectuelle revisitant l’arène de bataille en ligne multijoueur (oui, un MOBA); et collaborer avec une équipe d'experts polyvalents qui ont bien du fun à travailler ensemble. Venez construire l'avenir avec nous!

As Game AI Developer, you create and support AI systems, features and tools. You work closely with designers and other developers, guiding them towards a robust and evolutive implementation. You collaborate with peers and you make sure your work integrates well with the other game ingredients, providing the player with a unique gameplay experience.

Joining Amazon Games Montréal means taking part in the foundation of a new video game studio that operates at a focused, human scale; participating in the creation of a new intellectual property, a fresh take on the AAA multiplayer online battle arena game (yes, a MOBA); and collaborating with a team of well-rounded experts who have a great time working together. Come build the future with us!

Key job responsibilities

Responsabilités

Créer des systèmes et mécaniques d’IA;
Collaborer avec vos pairs pour assurer la fiabilité, les performances et la maintenabilité du jeu;
Contribuer à la conception du jeu.

Responsibilities

Implement AI systems and features;
Work with your peers to ensure reliability, performance and sustainability of the game features;
Contribute to the game vision.

About The Team

À propos de l'équipe

Nous développons et publions activement un portfolio de jeux, avec l'ambition de créer des destinations captivantes pour la découverte de nouveaux jeux et contenus. Pour y parvenir, nos divisions principales - Game Publishing, Game Development et Prime Gaming - collaborent avec nos partenaires externes pour développer, publier et livrer les meilleurs jeux AAA. Du concept aux services en ligne, nos équipes visent l'excellence dans la création d'univers de jeu captivants. Notre vision s'étend au-delà du présent : nous croyons en un avenir où chaque personne pourra créer, compétitionner, collaborer et connecter à travers les jeux. C'est pourquoi nous restons constamment à l'écoute des joueuses et des joueurs, nous permettant ainsi d'offrir des expériences exceptionnelles et un service de première classe. Au cœur de notre réussite se trouve la diversité de nos équipes : nous bâtissons un environnement inclusif qui profite autant à notre personnel qu'à notre clientèle. En rassemblant des personnes aux horizons variés et en leur donnant la liberté d'innover, nous créons un espace où chaque membre peut repousser ses limites, se challenger mutuellement et explorer de nouvelles façons de réaliser son plein potentiel.

About The Team

We’re actively developing and publishing a portfolio of games and aspire to create compelling destinations to discover new games and in-game content. Our core divisions: Game Publishing, Game Development and Prime Gaming work together with our external partners to develop, publish, and deliver the best AAA games. From concept to live services, our teams aim to be the best at creating worlds you want to play in. We believe in a future where everyone can create, compete, collaborate and connect through games. We listen to the players so we can deliver great, player-focused games and best-in-class service. We believe in building teams and products that reflect and offer an inclusive environment for all our employees and customers. By taking a diverse group from different backgrounds and giving them the freedom to be innovative and creative, we create an environment where our team members push boundaries, challenge each other, and learn new ways to unlock their full potential.

Basic Qualifications

Qualifications de base

Baccalauréat en informatique ou dans un domaine technique associé
Expertise en C++
5+ années d’expérience en développement de systèmes et de fonctionnalités pour des jeux AAA
2+ années d’expérience en développement de systèmes et de fonctionnalités d’IA pour des jeux AAA
Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, à l'oral et à l'écrit; puisque ce rôle nécessite d'interagir avec d’autres entités d’Amazon à l’échelle mondiale ainsi qu’avec des employé.es et intervenant.es dans d’autres provinces canadiennes, la connaissance du français et de l’anglais est exigée pour ce poste.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related technical field
Expertise in C++
5+ years experience developing game features for AAA video games

Strong verbal and written communication skills, in French and English; due to the nature of the role that requires interaction with other Amazon entities globally and with Amazon employees and stakeholders in other provinces in Canada, bilingualism French and English is required for this position.

Preferred Qualifications

Qualifications souhaitables

Expérience en comportement et navigation d’IA
Expérience en apprentissage automatique
Expérience avec Unreal 5 ou moteur similaire

Nous savons que votre talent et vos habilités peuvent s’exprimer par des expériences variées et pertinentes. Nous vous incitons donc à postuler, même si vous ne présentez peut-être pas toutes les qualifications listées.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with AI behavior and navigation
Experience in machine learning
Experience with Unreal 5 or similar game engine

The Category Leader – MRO, partners with all Operational functions and business partners to develop and execute long term Procurement strategies aligned with business goals. The Category Leader/Specialists primary function is to implement sound, innovative MRO supply strategies through market intelligence, sourcing, supplier selection, contract negotiation, and supplier performance management, using ADM’s 7-step sourcing process. The Category Leader will also develop processes to ensure stakeholder engagement and data-driven decision making. He/she will prepare non-disclosure agreements, requests for quotes/proposals and negotiate global agreements for numerous MRO categories.

Analyze supplier responses and make data-driven sourcing recommendations.
Act as prime negotiator with suppliers on price, terms, quality, service, and other business requirements. 
Develop and implement contractual framework in close cooperation with legal.
Establish short and long term category metrics and TCO savings targets, monitor performance, and communicate these to stakeholders.
Manage supplier expectations and key performance metrics.
Apply eSourcing best practices to all sourcing events.
Serve as a single point of contact for up to 20 MRO categories to ensure maximum leverage is consistently utilized. 
Establish robust communication plan to keep internal business partners informed of progress and benefits of Procurement activity.

Continuous Improvement

description:
This is a full time, exempt-level position.

The ideal work location for this position would be CLinton, IA or another U.S.-based ADM site. This is not a remote-work opportunity and the individual must report into an ADM site regularly for work.

Job Summary

The Maintenance Process Improvement (MPI) Practitioner role assesses, trains, coaches, implements, and ensures sustainability of Maintenance Process Improvement in the primary areas of Work Management and Planning/Scheduling, as well as the secondary areas of MRO (i.e. maintenance, repair and operations) and Warehousing at specifically-assigned, critical ADM plants.

This role works directly with the Plant Reliability Technology teams, Business Unit Reliability teams, and various site personnel. The person in this role is a leader in implementation, sustainability and continuous improvement. The MPI Practitioner will need to be able to quickly assess a maintenance organization and work management processes to determine gaps and the actions needed to close those gaps.

The MPI Practitioner may also be required to participate in ADM Task Force initiatives and ADM SWAT Team initiatives, which are highly-focused MPI execution initiatives. These initiatives will require the ability to be flexible, adaptable, and to be able to change course rapidly from the regular duties. The Task Force and SWAT Team initiatives are short duration and quick response in nature.

Specific Responsibilities

Extensive travel required from home of residence to various assigned plants
Assess current level of maturity for assigned sites’ CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System), MRO and Planning and Scheduling processes, determining gaps and determining the actions to close gaps
Develop plan with assigned sites for improving upon CMMS, MRO and Planning and Scheduling processes
Work closely with plant maintenance team, Business Unit Reliability teams and Plant Reliability Technology Center teams
Drive metrics, KPIs and monetary cost savings while improving safety, quality, delivery and cost
Implementation of effective usage of maintenance planning, scheduling and execution processes using ADM’s chosen computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS)
Executes measurable and seeable improvements during every visit to a plant
Ensures visibility of KPIs, trend management
Provide/share foundational best-practices
Implement a sustainable process to close gaps
Determine monetary savings at the plant and drive that savings

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Engineering, or a similar technical discipline
8+ years of experience in industrial maintenance
Demonstrated knowledge of maintenance work management processes
Demonstrated experience leading and motivating people
Knowledge of Maximo, Akwire and possibly SAP
Electrical or mechanical experience in a manufacturing maintenance and engineering environment
Demonstrated communication skills and leadership experience
Excellent written and oral communication skills

Preferred Qualifications:

CMRP or similar technical maintenance-related certification

ADM requires the successful completion of a background check. Relocation assistance may be available for this opportunity.

REF:99628BR

The pay range for this position is expected to be between:

$92,800.00 - $172,800.00

Benefits And Perks

Enriching the quality of life for the world begins by taking care of our colleagues. In addition to competitive pay, we support your diverse needs with a comprehensive total rewards package to enhance your well-being, including:

Physical wellness – medical/Rx, dental, vision and on-site wellness center access or gym reimbursement (as applicable).
Financial wellness – flexible spending accounts, health savings account, 401(k) with matching contributions and cash balance plan, discounted employee stock purchasing program, life insurance, disability, workers’ compensation, legal assistance, identity theft protection.
Mental and social wellness – Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) and Colleague Giving Programs (ADM Cares).

Additional Benefits Include

Paid time off including paid holidays.
Adoption assistance and paid maternity and parental leave.
Tuition assistance.
Company-sponsored training and development resources, such as LinkedIn Learning, language training and mentoring programs.

*Benefits may vary for bargained locations, confirm benefit eligibility with your recruiter.

Diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging are cornerstones of ADM’s efforts to continue innovating, driving growth, and delivering outstanding performance. We are committed to attracting and retaining a diverse workforce and create welcoming, truly inclusive work environments — environments that enable every ADM colleague to feel comfortable on the job, make meaningful contributions to our success, and grow their career. We respect and value the unique backgrounds and experiences that each person can bring to ADM because we know that diversity of perspectives makes us better, together.

description:
Job Description

Join Hallmark as a Part-Time Retail Merchandiser in Marshalltown, IA! This is your opportunity to represent the world's best-known greeting card brand and play a crucial role in merchandising, creating, and building displays within your territory for a positive shopper experience. We offer you work life integration within the work week, while supporting the business needs. You will be required to service stores based on the scheduling tool you are provided. We offer paid: training, travel time, and mileage reimbursement. Are you ready to make your mark?

Job Overview

As a Retail Merchandiser, you'll have the opportunity to work independently to showcase your organization and time management skills, your ability to establish retailer relationships, while being the face of Hallmark. You will collaborate with local store teams to optimize product placement and maintain inventory levels as well as support fellow team members with seasonal resets and installations, when needed. On occasion Hallmark may ask you to service another vendor's product in a store that you are assigned to. If that is the case, you will be provided detailed instructions and additional budgeted time.

To learn more about this role, please click here to watch our retail merchandisers in action.

SALARY AND SHIFT DETAILS 

Your starting pay will be between $16.00 - $18.00 depending on your shift and location.
This is a Part-Time position with a variable schedule during the work week.
Weekly hours for this position is between 5 – 10 hours per week
Availability the week before and after major holidays, which may include weekends is required.

Your Role And Responsibilities Will Include

You'll perform service work in the Hallmark department of various retail stores such as grocery stores, drug stores, department stores, and mass retailers. The retail merchandiser position consists of three major components:

Day-to-day engagement: You are responsible for the entire Hallmark product display at your assigned stores. Utilizing a mobile device provided by Hallmark, you'll restock, organize, and monitor the inventory of Hallmark products within and outside the Hallmark department. While using your mobile device you will also be in communication with your supervisor, reporting time, providing feedback, and answering surveys for required merchandising activities. Professional and courteous interaction with store employees, management, and customers is also vital for success in this role.
Holiday support: Hallmark's operations revolve around seasonal demand. Leading up to and following holidays such as Valentine's Day, Easter, Mother's Day, Father's Day, Halloween, Thanksgiving, and Christmas, you can expect additional days and extended hours during the work week. On occasions like Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, and Father's Day, you may be required to work on the actual holiday itself, which may include the weekend.
Department Resets: At times, you may be part of a team responsible for installations and various tasks like building and installing Hallmark fixtures, relocating card departments and products, as well as resetting card sections. Typically, you will be notified two weeks in advance for remodel assignments. This could include evenings or weekend.
One Team Vision: As a field organization although you are assigned to your specific responsibilities there may be additional work and installation efforts that you will be asked and required to support.

Physical Requirements

This is a physically demanding job that requires a high level of energy and a sense of urgency. You will be working on the selling floor as well as in back stockrooms. You must be able to consistently push, pull, lift, and carry cartons, merchandise, and display fixtures up to 30 pounds throughout the workday and up to 50 pounds on occasion. You will also be required to stoop, squat, walk, and stand throughout your workday, and you may be required to climb stairs and step ladders.

Basic Qualifications

You're at least 18 years of age.
You're able to read, write and understand English.
You have the ability to grasp, pull, lift, and carry products up to 30 pounds frequently and 50 pounds occasionally.
Able to operate hand-held technology provided to open and read documents and interpret
You have access to a Wi-Fi network and the internet.
You have reliable transportation to report to assigned locations.

Prior to applying, please click here to watch retail merchandisers at work. 

Now's your chance to Make Your Mark—just follow the instructions below to apply.

You must show how you meet the basic qualifications in a resume or document you upload, or by completing the work experience and education application fields. Accepted file types are DOCX and PDF.

Part-time employees with a work schedule less than 30 hours have access to a variety of voluntary benefits through Voluntary Benefits [mercerindigo.com]; including dental, vision, critical illness, accident insurance, hospital indemnity and minimum essential coverage (preventive care).

Driven by imagination, intention and purpose, Patcraft creates high-performance flooring solutions for every market sector. 30 years ago, Dr. Barnes founded Eyemart Express to deliver everything a patient needs. It started with one friendly shop in Appleton, WI, and has since expanded to over 245 in 42 states. Today, Eyemart Express is celebrated for promptly delivering quality eyewear at great prices while maintaining great relationships with optometrists and local communities. We’re not like everyone else, with local labs in stores, eye exams, and same-day delivery on glasses — our customers never miss a moment. Now, you can join one of the nation’s top optical retailers and improve lives by helping people see better.

As a Lead Optical Retail Sales Associate (Key Holder), you will play a crucial role in assisting patients with their eyewear needs and ensuring they receive exceptional service. Your leadership skills and retail experience will be vital in maintaining our high standards of customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.

Customer Service: Provide exceptional service and maintain knowledge of current sales, promotions, and policies regarding payment, returns, and exchanges.

Administrative Tasks: Perform other administrative tasks as assigned, including processing insurance claims and maintaining patient files. 
Product Knowledge: Maintain up-to-date knowledge of products and assist in the stocking and straightening of merchandise. 

Requirements

High School Diploma or GED 
Experience working in retail, customer service, or sales 
Experience in the optical industry is preferred 
Experience in a lead or management position is preferred 
Ability to correctly read and interpret prescription specifications and input into the computer to ensure lenses are cut properly 

Benefits

Dental Insurance

Short-Term and Long-Term Disability 
Life Insurance 
Fully paid benefits to maintain licensing requirements and opportunities for advancement

description:
YOUR OPPORTUNITY

We have an exciting Regional Market Selector Supervisor opportunity in Iowa Falls, IA.

In this highly impactful role, you will identify hog sales using market hog sales requirements and schedules while assisting in the oversight of selector performance and conducting training and audits.

About Us

At Seaboard Foods, we create the most sought-after pork. A top U.S. pork producer/processor and leading exporter to 30+ countries, we are committed to bringing excellence to the table, seeking a better way to produce wholesome pork, and connecting every step between our farms and family tables. More than 5,400 employees in five states work on our farms, feed mills, and processing plant to produce Prairie Fresh® pork, ensuring the well-being of our animals, the environment, our employees, and the communities we call home. Our commitment to sustainability is reflected in our renewable gas projects on our farms creating renewable energy. Owned by Seaboard Corporation, a Fortune 500 company, and nominated as one of the “Best Places to Work” by Kansas City’s Business Journal, we have a dynamic culture where our employees can contribute and understand why they matter.

Responsibilities

Oversee key performance indicators for selectors in the region and implement individual and/or group training to address deficiencies in performance. 
Perform selector site audits and conduct in-field follow-ups for sites suspected of selecting/loadout issues and communicate results to the necessary parties.
Participate in monthly/quarterly marketing strategy discussions with leadership. 
Assesses hog body composition in finishing sites to project sales according to marketing requirements. 
Identify and mark hogs to be moved or sold to the appropriate destination.
Deliver load movement paperwork to necessary farm sites in a timely fashion. 
Communicate regularly with leadership and production about group performance and provide data through written reports and email correspondence.
Count inventory and number of hogs scheduled for sale as applicable.
Assist other team members to effectively meet department and company goals. 

CORE COMPETENCIES FOR SUCCESS IN ALL ROLES: instills trust, communicates effectively, action-oriented, ensures accountability, and drives results.

Required

QUALIFICATIONS 

Associate degree or equivalent from a two-year college or technical school preferred. Minimum of 1-3 years swine production experience and/or training.
A clear and valid driver's license and clean motor vehicle record (MVR) required. 

SCHEDULE 

The hours and days of work are established by departmental needs and at the discretion of management.

Compensation

We offer a competitive pay rate based on your skills and experience related to this position.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The physical and work demands listed here represent those an employee should possess to successfully perform the job's essential functions. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to move around the facility. 
The employee must regularly lift and move up to 100 pounds, and occasionally lift and move up to 300 pounds. 
Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

description:
Descripción del empleo

Este es un puesto de trabajo remoto.

En Oberstaff, contratamos profesionales altamente calificados en América Latina y los asignamos a trabajar de forma remota a tiempo completo con empresas de todo el mundo. Nuestro proceso de selección garantiza talento especializado y alineado con las necesidades de cada negocio, permitiendo a nuestros clientes fortalecer sus equipos con profesionales eficientes, comprometidos y preparados para impulsar su crecimiento.

Nuestro cliente es una empresa con 5 años de existencia en la industria de Promoción de Eventos, Conciertos. El horario de operaciones es de 8:00am a 8:00pm en horario de España. Nos han pedido encontrar a un profesional dedicado al Programador Full Stack Especializado en IA y N8N.

Buscamos un profesional en el área de la programación Full Stack, que se encargará de impulsar la transformación tecnológica de la empresa. El candidato será responsable de desarrollar, mantener y optimizar los sistemas internos, plataformas web y soluciones de automatización, además de tener capacidad de independencia, autonomía y hacer propuestas para el mejoramiento de los procesos. Con sólidos conocimientos en Backend y Frontend, con una visión estratégica de IA como machine learning, redes neuronales, integración de APIs de IA como GPT, visión computacional o análisis de datos y automatización de decisiones inteligentes en procesos comerciales o de software.

Sus Funciones Serán

Diseñar, desarrollar e implementar sistemas internos de la agencia con alta eficiencia y escalabilidad
Crear y mantener aplicaciones web y plataformas digitales
Desarrollar integraciones entre diferentes sistemas y plataformas utilizando N8N
Implementar soluciones de automatización con inteligencia artificial
Gestionar y optimizar infraestructura tecnológica
Realizar mantenimiento continuo y mejora de sistemas existentes
Proponer e implementar nuevas soluciones tecnológicas que aumenten la productividad.

Perfil Técnico

Lenguajes: JavaScript, Python, Node.js
Frameworks: React, Vue.js, Angular
Herramientas: Docker, Kubernetes
Bases de datos: MongoDB, PostgreSQL
Servicios en la nube: Google Cloud Platform

Requisitos

Disponibilidad para trabajar en el horario de Lunes a Viernes de 11:00 am a 8:00 pm Horario España, con una hora de descanso. 
Poseer equipo técnico de PC o Laptop con conexión mayor a 100 mbps.
Capacidad para trabajar con calendarios de entrega.
Experiencia mínima de 4 años en desarrollo de software
Dominio de programación Full Stack
Conocimientos avanzados en automatización de procesos
Experiencia en desarrollo de integraciones entre plataformas
Sólidos conocimientos de N8N
Manejo de lenguajes de programación modernos
Capacidad para trabajar en proyectos tecnológicos complejos
Excelentes habilidades de resolución de problemas
Compromiso con la mejora continua

Habilidades Deseables

Conocimientos de Google Cloud
Experiencia con Google App Builder y Google App Sheet
Conocimientos de macOS scripting
Experiencia en diseño UX/UI

Ventajas

Horario totalmente remoto.
Independencia de ubicación.
Contrato de servicios profesionales (por cuenta propia) con paga fija mensual.
Paga en dólares USD a través de PayPal.
Sumarte a una empresa en constante crecimiento, con un excelente clima de trabajo, posibilidades de desarrollo profesional.

(English below)

À propos de Waveshaper AI
Waveshaper AI révolutionne le traitement audio grâce à une intelligence artificielle prête pour l’edge computing, apportant un son de qualité studio à tout appareil. Notre technologie brevetée d’apprentissage audio-à-audio alimente des modèles neuronaux ultra-légers pour un traitement audio en temps réel.

À propos du poste
Nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur(e) Senior en IA Audio ayant un esprit entrepreneurial pour développer des modèles neuronaux audio destinés au déploiement sur des appareils edge. Vous stimulerez l’innovation en apprentissage machine tout en évoluant rapidement dans un environnement startup.

Responsabilités principales :
1. Développement ML Audio
Concevoir et entraîner des modèles neuronaux pour le traitement audio (réduction de bruit, amélioration de la parole, amélioration de la qualité)
Évaluer la qualité audio via des écoutes subjectives et des métriques objectives

Déployer les modèles sur diverses plateformes et configurations matérielles

Prendre des décisions techniques malgré des informations incomplètes et itérer rapidement
Travailler directement avec les clients pour valider les solutions et recueillir des retours
Trouver l’équilibre entre excellence technique et délais de livraison produit
Transformer des avancées en IA audio en fonctionnalités prêtes pour le marché

Expertise Audio & ML
5+ ans d’expérience en traitement du signal audio et développement de modèles ML

Expérience en MLOps et systèmes ML en production

Motivation entrepreneuriale, capacité à évoluer rapidement et à s’adapter

Capacité à travailler dans des environnements dynamiques et en évolution rapide

Qualifications souhaitées :
Diplôme en informatique, ingénierie ou domaine connexe
Expérience dans l’industrie audio ou les systèmes audio en temps réel
Expérience avec des frameworks ML edge (TensorFlow Lite, ONNX)
Expérience en environnement startup

Ce que nous offrons :
Responsabilités techniques sur une technologie IA audio de pointe
Participation au capital d’une startup en pleine croissance dans le traitement audio
Autonomie technique et impact direct sur le produit
Rémunération compétitive à Montréal (options de télétravail disponibles)

Prêt(e) à révolutionner l’IA audio ? Rejoignez-nous pour construire un traitement audio intelligent pour les appareils edge.

Waveshaper AI revolutionizes audio processing with edge-ready AI that brings studio-quality sound to any device. Our patented audio-to-audio learning technology powers ultra-lightweight neural models for real-time audio processing.

About the Role
We're seeking a Senior Audio AI Engineer with an entrepreneurial mindset to develop neural audio models for edge deployment. Drive breakthrough ML innovations while moving fast in a startup environment.

Key Responsibilities :
1. Audio ML Development
Design and train neural audio processing models for noise reduction, speech enhancement, and quality improvement
Evaluate audio quality using both subjective listening and objective metrics
Build scalable ML pipelines and audio data strategies
Develop model architectures optimized for real-time audio applications
2. Model Optimization & Deployment
Implement model compression, quantization, and pruning techniques
Optimize ML models for edge devices with memory and latency constraints
Deploy models across diverse platforms and hardware configurations
Build MLOps pipelines for training, versioning, and automated deployment
3. Startup Innovation
Make technical decisions with incomplete information and iterate rapidly
Work directly with customers to validate solutions and gather feedback
Balance technical excellence with product delivery timelines
Translate audio AI breakthroughs into market-ready features

Qualifications :
Audio & ML Expertise
5+ years audio signal processing and ML model development
Deep understanding of audio quality metrics and perceptual audio processing
Experience with neural network architectures for audio applications
Proficiency with TensorFlow, PyTorch, and audio ML frameworks
Model Optimization
3+ years experience with model compression and edge deployment
Knowledge of quantization, pruning, and distillation techniques
Understanding of resource-constrained optimization
Experience with MLOps and production ML systems
Startup Mindset
Entrepreneurial drive to move fast and adapt quickly
Experience with cloud platforms (GCP/AWS) and ML infrastructure
Strong Python programming and data engineering skills
Ability to work in fast-paced, evolving environments

Preferred Qualifications :
Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
Audio industry or real-time audio systems experience
Experience with edge ML frameworks (TensorFlow Lite, ONNX)
Startup environment experience

What We Offer :
Technical ownership of cutting-edge audio AI technology
Equity in high-growth audio processing startup
Technical autonomy and direct product impact
Competitive package in Montreal (remote options available)

Ready to revolutionize audio AI? Join us in building intelligent audio processing for edge devices

Job Details

Job Location: Dubuque Branch - Dubuque, IA

Salary Range: Undisclosed

Description

Overview/Function: The Route Driver plays a key role in the sales process of Atlantic Coca-Cola Bottling Company products, making timely deliveries to various customer locations. They may also help in setting out and/or rotating new product and adjusting point-of-sale displays.

Major Responsibilities

Follow work orders and standard operating procedures (SOPs) while making deliveries of Atlantic Coca-Cola Bottling company products to customer sites along designated route 
Follow all DOT laws and company policies and standards. 
Unload vehicle at customer site, moving product to designated location(s), filling shelves, rotating stock, building displays, and receiving prior unsold goods (credits) 
Follow all safety regulations. Maintain clean and orderly work area at customer site to ensure safety for themselves and customers. 
Ensure professional contact with customers and maintain a clean and neat appearance at all times in order to favorably represent the company and iconic Coca-Cola brand image. 
Ethical conduct is expected at all times. 
Other duties as required. 

Qualifications

Experience & Qualifications:

High school diploma/GED. 
No greater than 2 moving violations, and no OWIs in the last five years 
Class A CDL with air brakes is required . (We will help candidate to obtain.) 
Excellent customer service communication skills in order to interact with customers. Must provide professional contact and appearance with customers which upholds Atlantic Bottlings brand image. 
Ability to read and follow directions and work orders 
Ability to follow all safety requirements/protocols 
Customer-focused and an excellent team-player. 
Flexible with the ability to adapt to varying situations. 
Some light computer experience is helpful. 
Regular, consistent attendance is an essential job function. 
Must have reliable transportation. 

Additional

The role will travel to various customer sites; each environment will differ as a result. 
This position is very active and requires the employee to stay alert and focused while driving. They will frequently lift and/or move items up to 55 lbs. (Moving equipment and tools will be provided to reduce strains and injury.) 
Standing, walking, twisting, grasping, reaching, pushing, pulling, bending, kneeling, sitting, stooping, crouching, crawling, and climbing will be required. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus. 
The route driver will frequently interact with customers. The ability to climb stairs is also needed. 
Extensive day travel will be required with this role. 
To accomplish their tasks, the position will need to work around variety of weather environments which Iowa offers (i.e. sun, rain, sleet, rain, snow, cold, heat) 
The role is considered a safety sensitive position. 

This position is budgeted $24.00-$30.00 per hour. More great benefits can be found on our career page: atlanticbottling.com/careers.

Note: No posting can contain a fully comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required in this role. Atlantic Coca-Cola Bottling Company offers a dynamic, ever-changing environment requiring flexibility and a willing, team-based attitude. Some duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time, with or without notice.

To ensure the safety of our employees, our customers, and our products, Atlantic Coca-Cola Bottling Company offers a drug-free workplace. Employees are subject to pre-employment/post-offer physical, drug screen, and random drug testing.

The Territory Sales Lead (TSL) ensures flawless execution of store level sales and promotion plans with customer retailers in assigned territory. Consultative Business Partnering

Customer Relationship Development and Management:

Obtain and analyze relevant store, product, and market data and leverage trends and analytics to build the business.

Effectively solve problems by analyzing information, utilizing consumer trends and customer insights to guide decision making and influence others to act. 

Sales:

Engage in forward selling via consultative sales techniques using provided data sources, technology, processes and procedures. 
Maximize sales and display opportunities by conducting store walk-throughs and gaining commitment by KDMs on successful outcomes. 
Tailor strategies to influence KDMs to order additional products to increase incremental sales and to obtain best in class quality of merchandising locations. 

Merchandising

Achieve all merchandising objectives executing customer specific promotional plans to the sales floor using forward selling. Partnership at store level is critical for TSL’s to effectively build, maintain and execute product on the sales floor, in addition to merchandising and maintaining permanent secondary displays and other display vehicles

Administrative Responsibilities

Complete and submit reports of daily and weekly activities, expenses, competitive activity, account changes, promotions and all administrative functions within assigned territory using company approved methods and technology

Qualifications

Education and Experience:

2-year Associate/Community College degree required OR 3 years of previous sales experience.

description:
Wellabe is seeking a hybrid Sr Investment Accountant who play a crucial role in managing and overseeing the Company's

investment accounting activities. This position requires a deep understanding of investment strategies,

financial reporting, and regulatory compliance. The ideal candidate will be adept at navigating change

and driving improvements in our investment accounting processes.

Be successful in this role

Someone in this role will be able to do the following essential functions:

Investment Accounting: Manage and oversee the accounting for the company's investment portfolio, including fixed income, equities, and alternative investments, and the external third-party investment accounting relationship.
Financial Reporting: Prepare and review complex investment accounting entries, reconciliations, schedules, and reports, ensuring accuracy and compliance with Statutory accounting standards.
Analysis and Reporting: Conduct detailed analysis and provide insightful reports to senior management to inform strategic decision-making.
Regulatory Compliance: Ensure adherence to regulatory requirements and industry standards, including monitoring changes in regulations and implementing necessary adjustments.
Process Improvement: Identify opportunities for process enhancements and lead initiatives to streamline investment accounting processes and procedures.
Change Management: Support the Company through upcoming changes in the investment industry, insurance regulation, and the Company investment strategy by providing expertise in investment accounting and associated reporting.
Collaboration: Work closely with other departments, including finance, treasury, and risk management, to ensure cohesive and comprehensive financial strategies.
Leadership: Lead, direct, mentor, and coach less experienced staff; either indirectly or through supervisory responsibilities.

Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance or related field. Combination of education and/or relevant work experience may be accepted in lieu of degree.
CPA or CFA preferred.
Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in investment accounting, preferably within the insurance industry.
Strong knowledge of Statutory Accounting and regulatory requirements along with the ability to ensure compliance and provide documentation both internally and externally
Proven ability to manage and understand complex investment accounting and reporting
Excellent organizational, communication and other interpersonal skills
Advanced analytical skills with the ability to assess and resolve problems proactively, think critically and methodically, and use logic and make sound decisions
Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage time, projects/resources and set priorities to maintain efficient workflow
Ownership mindset for all aspects of the role
Experience with change management and process improvement initiatives in both a leading and performance capacity
Proficiency in financial software, investment accounting systems (Clearwater), MS Office Suite

Benefits

Hybrid availability
401(k) with generous, full vested company match
Health insurance
Paid time off, holidays
Volunteer time off
Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA)
Paternal leave
Legal insurance
EAP
Travel accident insurance

Growth opportunities

Skills

We believe each of us has potential to grow and adapt with our business. We take your career as seriously as you do. Helping you develop your skills and talents leads to opportunities — not only for you, but also for our company. That’s why we provide:

LinkedIn Learning Premium access
CliftonStrengths® assessment and coaching
On-site and virtual workshops and cohorts featuring world-class content from FranklinCovey, Crucial Learning, Gallup, and more 
Free world-class insurance acumen courses through AHIP and LOMA
Reimbursement and bonus opportunities for professional designations and certifications, including a tuition reimbursement program 
Opportunities to take part in Wellabe's mentorship programs

Since 1929, Wellabe has been finding solutions to help our customers protect their health and financial well-being. And we’re committed to fostering an internal culture of inclusivity, well-being, and development so each of our team members can succeed. Learn more about Wellabe’s culture of betterment by visiting wellabe.com/culture.

Wellabe is full of smart, caring, hard-working people with a broad range of talents who understand collaboration is key. We bring our best selves every day, to connect with others to solve problems, spark innovation, and bring ideas to life. Meet the team and learn what makes Wellabe a great place to work by visiting wellabe.com/news/employee-spotlights.

Be dedicated: Show unwavering commitment by proactively taking initiative, setting clear goals, and managing time effectively.
Be trustworthy: Take accountability for actions, navigate difficult conversations with integrity, and build strong relationships through consistent, honest behavior.
Be determined: Demonstrate enthusiasm and a relentless drive to overcome obstacles and achieve goals.
Be collaborative: Foster teamwork by being self-aware, actively listening, and effectively communicating across all levels.
Be open: Embrace diversity and new ideas to create an inclusive environment.
Be generous: Embody generosity and compassion by serving a greater purpose and helping others.
Be better: Commit to continuous improvement and adapt effectively to change.
Be well: Prioritize physical and mental health, manage stress, and demonstrate emotional intelligence.

Be well – thrive in an environment that fosters inclusivity, well-being, and development.

description:
Iowa Select Farms Job Description

TITLE: Wean to Finish Supervisor 

REPORTS TO: Wean to Finish Senior Supervisor 

LAST REVISION DATE: 05.31.2022 

Company Values

We believe in doing the right thing every day, operating with character and integrity, and being stewards of our resource by committing to: 
Our Animals 
Our People 
Our Environment 
Our Community 
The core values of an organization are those values we hold which form the foundation on which we perform work and conduct ourselves. We expect all leaders, managers, and employees to demonstrate, foster and promote: 
Respect: We treat people with respect regardless of personal opinions or differing backgrounds, and no one within the organization is more or less important than anyone else 
Accountability: We hold ourselves accountable for completing our job responsibilities and following through on our commitments. We encompass our ability to recognize our own strengths and areas for improvement as well as accept responsibility for the performance and actions of ourselves and our teams without blaming others 
Good Decision-Making: We are expected to continuously improve processes, attain results, and create efficiencies to achieve our mission while solving problems based on a combination of factual information, analysis, wisdom, and experience 
Flexibility: We must react to changing circumstances, ambiguity and uncertainty with confidence, openness, positive energy, and optimism. 

Purpose Of Position

Lead and direct a team of employees and contractors that are responsible for care, production performance, site maintenance, site appearance and controller cost and maximizing revenue. 

Essential Job Functions And Responsibilities

Conduct site visits to ensure management team is giving proper care and management to animals and following all ISF animal well-being policies .
The 3 company expectations listed in section below are all tracked via audits, you play a critical role in the success of audits for the entire farm which also impacts incentive payouts. 
Execute and implement strategies to achieve production and economic goals of the company and specific geographic area including production performance, revenue and marketing, and cost management KPI’s. 
Communicate with Supervisors and Sr. Supervisors on the size and quality of your sites. 
Forecast, select and mark hogs for market along with observing the newly placed pigs when sites are filled. 
Assure site managers have necessary training, supplies and tools to provide proper swine care 
Work with transportation department on the efficient flow of pigs in and out of sites. 
Partner with site managers in managing the environment and environmental controls while educating manager on troubleshooting ventilation issues. 
Help your site managers monitor all nutrient storage facilities and to report issues immediately. 
Instruct and train managers on proper swine drug administration: mixing directions, quantity for injection and withdrawal times to meet ISF protocols . 
Monitor overall health of pigs and communicate with Staff Veterinarian and Senior Finishing Supervisor on what is happening in the field. 
Administration of ISF protocols for site maintenance and pig management. 
Responsible to understand and troubleshoot alarm systems and calls and ensure a response is initiated for 100% of these calls, acting as a backup to site managers on all alarm calls. 
Assist with hiring (referrals, farm tours, etc.) 
Evaluate, discipline, and terminate employees in partnership with HR/ Supervisor. 
Promote and demonstrate safe animal handling practices. 
Provide feedback to senior management. 
Ability to run generator and portable generator correctly. 
Follow company guidelines for vehicle usage. 
Pick up and deliver supplies in a timely manner. 
Work with site managers to identify animals needing timely euthanasia. 
Complete euthanasia process according to ISF protocols. 
Understand daily production numbers and factors that impact those goals as well as the steps the farm is taking to achieve those goals. 
Understanding company production and incentive packages and educating employees to achieve these results. 
Responsible for ensuring employees work in a safe manner and use personal protective equipment (PPE) when required, keeping employees motivated to perform at a high level to achieve production results and ensure all employees are being trained. 
Help management team create routines within the farm that result in passed audits. 
Help management team create and execute action plans based off audit results.

description:
Imagine yourself

Growing your expertise and expanding your skillset with every project.
Owning your ambition and fueling your career growth.
Thriving in a supportive team environment that inspires you to strive for excellence.


At Hach (www.hach.com), a Veralto company, we ensure water quality for people around the world, and every team member plays a vital role in that mission. Our founding vision is to make water analysis better—faster, simpler, greener, and more informative. We accomplish this through teamwork, customer partnerships, passionate experts, and reliable, easy-to-use solutions.

As part of our team and the broader Veralto network, you’ll be part of a unique work environment where purpose meets possibility: where you’ll make an immediate, measurable impact on a global scale by enabling the world’s everyday water needs, and where you’ll have opportunities to foster your professional development and fuel your career growth.

Motivated by the highest possible stakes in climate change and global health, we’re working together within a rapidly digitizing industry to find innovative technologies that guarantee the safety of our water and our environment.

More about us: https://www.hach.com/about-us

The Operator II is responsible for manufacturing quality product according to the work order or other build signal while adhering to defined work instructions. General duties may include picking, assembling, and packaging. Machine set-up and equipment operation may be required.

Schedule: Monday through Thursday, from 5:00 am to 3:30 pm. Overtime might be required.

In this role, a typical day will look like:

Prepare machines to start a production cycle٫ performing calibration٫ cleaning and other activities
Monitor and properly adjust machine settings
Check parts with precision٫ using appropriate measuring tools
Conduct tests to check the operation of machines٫ on a regular basis
Troubleshoot issues that might occur during the shift
Verify output to detect any machine-related mistakes or flaws
Create and manage records of approved and defective units or final products
Create and maintain activity logs
Adhere to health and safety regulations
Possess manual dexterity and good coordination
Possess basic reading, writing, and math skills
Possess proven mechanical ability or aptitude
Possess ability to resolve minor problems, recognize normal and unusual situations
Ability to learn machine operations (including set up and changeover), and/or kitting.
Some areas will require the ability to work with manual and/or power equipment.
Must have good oral and written communication skills.


The essential requirements of the job include:

HS diploma/GED or equivalent preferred
Six months production experience required
Six months mechanical experience or equivalent required
Possess proven mechanical ability or aptitude
Ability to learn machine operations (including set up and changeover), and/or kitting.
Some areas will require the ability to work with manual and/or power equipment.


ENVIRONMENT:

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. 

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to reach with hands and arms. The employee is constantly required to sit. The employee may occasionally squat, turn/twist, or reach. The employee is constantly using hands to: finger, handle, feel or operate objects, and computer keyboards. The employee is occasionally required to walk, stand, climb, balance, stoop, bend, kneel, crouch or crawl, and talk, hear, and smell.

The employee must frequently lift, carry, push or pull up to 20 pounds and occasionally lift, carry, push or pull up to 50 pounds.

Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

While performing the duties of this job, the employee may be subjected to moving mechanical parts, electrical currents, vibrations, fumes, odors, dusts, gases, chemicals, oils, extreme temperatures and workspace restrictions.

The noise level in the work environment is occasionally loud.

Employees will be required to wear the proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) which may include: eye, hearing and respiratory protection, protective smock, steel toe shoes, gloves, hard hats, or face shields. Contacts are not allowed.

PRE-EMPLOYMENT TESTING

External hiring into this position is contingent upon the successful completion of a pre-employment drug screen and background check and possible pre-employment physical and/or credit history review. Hach will consider qualified candidates with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable local, state, and Federal Law.

You can apply for this role through the Careers Page at https://jobs.veralto.com/global/en/hach (or through the Workday “Find Jobs” function if you are a current employee)

US ONLY:

The below range reflects the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. An associate’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors, including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs.

The compensation range for this role is $20.00 - $20.00 USD per hour. This job is also eligible for Bonus Pay.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.
